messages:
maria: Quick kv-cache pass — comparing hit% vs p99 by seqlen buckets and across regions. TL;DR: prefetch helps mid-length contexts (256-1024) in us-west, but in eu-central we see p99 regressions for seqlen >= 2048. chart: https://ci.internal/runs/1789/artifacts/kv-hitlatency-20260319.png 

bench-bot: CI run 2026-03-19 22:04: summary attached. us-west-2 p50/p95/p99 by seqlen: 8/22/38ms (64), 10/28/45ms (256), 18/55/120ms (1024), 40/120/310ms (4096). hit% (same order): 92%, 86%, 72%, 54%. artifact: https://ci.internal/runs/1789/logs

anya: ran isolated sweeps this morning (LRU vs CLOCK vs soft-evict). short notes: LRU+prefetch(256) best for 64/256/512 buckets (hit up ~4-6pts, p99 down ~15-30ms). For 2048/4096 CLOCK or soft-evict has less churn -> better p99. Prefetch window 512 reduces miss penalty but increases cross-region tail in eu-central (noisy NICs + kernel fallback).

leo: kernel detail: on A100 in us-west cutlass-2.3 matmul path reduces generation stall for long KV merges. in eu we hit a fallback to a generic kernel for sequences > 2048 on our old runtime build -> explains p99 diff. recommend forcing cutlass-2.3 where supported.

sam: Suggest trying age-weighted (soft) eviction with a small reserved slab (0.75) to avoid thrash on tail requests. Also consider lowering prefetch window to 256 for eu-central. small change, big impact on churn.

infra-bot: quick region snapshot: us-west-2 (A100s) avg util 62%, p99 with prefetch(256)+soft-evict = 92ms for 4096; eu-central-1 (V100/older) avg util 78%, p99=310ms with prefetch(512) (matches bench-bot). network RTT diff ~28ms between regions.

maria: Good. Let's run a controlled matrix: eviction={LRU,soft}, prefetch={256,512}, kernel={cutlass-2.3,default}, seqlen-buckets={64,256,1024,4096}, regions={us-west-2,eu-central-1}. Use batch=auto, quant=fp16. Command I used locally: ```./run_kv_bench --model vicuna-13b-q4 --prefetch 256 --evict-policy soft --seqlen-buckets 64,256,1024,4096 --regions us-west-2,eu-central-1 --kernels cutlass-2.3,default --batch auto``` @bench-bot can you queue that matrix and tag results to this thread? I'll open an eval to track quality regressions vs our golden prompt set.

bench-bot: queued matrix run #1791 (ETA ~3h). results will be posted here + CSV link.

maria: thanks — after results let's focus on turning the kernel selection into a routing policy (prefer cutlass on A100s for long contexts) and a per-region prefetch default. will file infra/runbook updates once we have numbers. :thumbsup:
